items.en: I work in a big warehouse.
The break starts at half past twelve.
Put the heavy boxes on the bottom shelf.
My shift finishes at ten in the evening.
The forklift driver needs more empty pallets.
We have already packed most of the orders for today.
If the scanner stops working, tell your team leader.
The delivery was delayed because of the traffic.
All damaged goods must be reported before the end of the shift.
Unless we receive the missing parts, the order will not be completed on time.
Where can I find the safety vests?
